rationale: Action buttons in tables (view, edit, delete) use only icons without text or aria-labels. Screen readers announce these as 'button' or 'link' without context, making the interface inaccessible to visually impaired users
problemSolved: Icon buttons like <a href='...' class='btn btn-icon btn-sm btn-primary' title='Ver Detalhes'> lack aria-label. The title attribute provides hover tooltips but is not announced by screen readers by default.
